gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-mayan-nume: Noto Sans Mayan Numerals stands tall in its small letters and leaves a visibly gaping c, while Bevellier packs its stencil-flat strokes shoulder to shoulder. Graceful on one side, brisk on the other.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-medefaidri: Stencil-cut strokes that hold one width through every turn give Bevellier its flat, sophisticated look up top. And Noto Sans Medefaidrin follows as a plain sans whose lowercase climbs high, with no ink pooling where curves fold in.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-meetei-may: Flat, tightly packed, almost cut from paper: that is Bevellier. Noto Sans Meetei Mayek then runs underneath with large lowercase eyes and rounds that gap like a cracked bangle, so a longer passage feels open and modern.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-mende-kika: Graceful is the first word for Bevellier, whose single line of constant weight traces every letter with tight sidebearings. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui is the clean foil, its tall lowercase letting daylight through each curve.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Sophisticated and flat-cut, Bevellier draws with one unchanging pen line. Noto Sans Meroitic settles below it, approachable, with see-through c openings and lowercase that fills the line almost like capitals, so a longer passage moves along easily.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-modi: Bevellier looks drawn with a compass pencil, every stroke held to one width and set with very close sidebearings. Noto Sans Modi sits under it, clean and sans-serif.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-mono: Stencil-flat and tightly spaced, Bevellier looks like ribbon cut to a single width, with a wide, squat-ascendered lowercase. Noto Sans Mono loosens everything below, its tall, sturdy letters spaced so nothing bumps.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-mro: Sophisticated from the first glance, Bevellier cuts each stroke as stout as a drawn pipe cleaner, packed with very close sidebearings. Bevellier handles the grand gesture, while Noto Sans Mro handles the dense, tall running text.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-multani: Graceful and flat, Bevellier keeps a pen at constant pressure and angle, leaving its wide lowercase with squat ascenders. And Noto Sans Multani, with its lofty x-height and gap-terminal e, leaves the big short lines to Bevellier.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-myanmar: Noto Sans Myanmar lays down a thick, heavy-looking strip of text with a broad c, while Bevellier cuts every stroke to one width above it. Flat stencil lines meet dense, open text.
